stem: We went to the museum early ____ we could see the new collection.
expl: so that 引导目的状语从句,表示「为了能……」;从句常与 could/can/would 等表示可能性的词连用。

stem: The old silk was ____ beautiful that everyone stopped to look at it.
expl: so 修饰形容词 beautiful,与 that 从句构成「如此……以至于……」的结果状语从句。such 只能修饰名词。

stem: It was ____ a valuable find that the news went around the world.
expl: such 后接「a + 形容词 + 名词」构成结果状语从句;so 只能直接修饰形容词或副词,不能带冠词与名词。

stem: The archaeologist spoke slowly ____ we could all understand him.
expl: so that 引导目的状语从句,说明「说得慢」的目的是让大家都能听懂。

stem: They worked ____ carefully that nothing was broken.
expl: so 修饰副词 carefully,与 that 从句构成结果状语从句。such 不能修饰副词。

stem: Take a photo of the design ____ we can study it at home.
expl: so that 引导目的状语从句,表示拍照的目的;从句用 can 表示能够。

stem: He is ____ a careful worker that we all take pride in him.
expl: such 后接「a + 形容词 + 名词」;so 不能直接修饰名词短语。

stem: The museum keeps the room cool ____ the silk may last longer.
expl: so that 引导目的状语从句,从句用情态动词 may 表示希望达成的结果。若用 because 则变成解释原因,与「保持房间凉爽是手段」的语义不符。

stem: It was such ____ interesting cartoon that we watched it twice.
expl: such 后接单数可数名词时须加冠词;interesting 以元音音素开头,故用 an。

stem: The design was so ____ that it soon became a hit.
expl: so 直接修饰形容词,后面不加冠词;「so + 形容词 + that 从句」构成结果状语从句。

stem: We saved every piece ____ the museum could bring them out again.
expl: so that 引导目的状语从句,说明保存每一块碎片的目的;从句用 could 与主句过去时呼应。

stem: —Why did they build the wall here?  —____ the wind could not break the young trees.
expl: 问句问的是建墙的目的,故用 so that 引导目的状语从句,并用 could not 表示要避免的结果。

stem: Which sentence expresses PURPOSE, not result?
opts: The find was so important that it made the news.
They dug slowly so that nothing would break.
It was such a big find that everyone came.
The room was so dark that we turned on more lights.
expl: so that 引导目的状语从句,表示做某事「为了」达成什么;而 so/such … that 引导结果状语从句,表示程度导致的结果。B 项说明「慢慢挖」的目的,其余三项都是「如此……以至于……」的结果。

stem: It was ____ that the whole team took pride in the work.
expl: such 后接「a + 形容词 + 名词」的语序;so 只能修饰形容词或副词本身,不能带冠词与名词,故其余三项语序或搭配均不成立。

stem: Choose the pair that fits: "We turned on more lights ____ the visitors ____ see the small designs on the silk."
expl: 空一需要引导目的状语从句的 so that;空二的情态动词要与主句谓语 turned on 的过去时呼应,故用 could 而非 can。
